<!--
Layout for one dashboard page (the All page and each site page). Knitted once
per page by quant_consent_dashboard.qmd with `page_df` (that page's records)
set. Blocks between ALL-ONLY-START / ALL-ONLY-END appear on the All page only.
The leading "_" keeps Quarto from rendering this file on its own.
-->

```{r}
#| include: false
vb <- consent_counts(page_df)
```

<!-- Red: incomplete consent from someone who said Yes (contact them).
Yellow: every other record with a problem (data to fix). Each record appears in
at most one banner; both are empty when there is nothing to flag. -->

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
followup_needed_banner(page_df)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
record_issues_banner(page_df)
```

## Row {height="5%" .fill}

<!-- Consent forms = every REDCap record that reached the consent instrument. -->

```{r}
#| title: Consent Forms Started
#| content: valuebox
list(icon = "file-earmark-text", color = "vb-green", value = vb$started)
```

```{r}
#| title: Consented
#| content: valuebox
list(icon = "check2-circle", color = "vb-green", value = vb$consented)
```

```{r}
#| title: Declined
#| content: valuebox
list(icon = "x-circle", color = "vb-green", value = vb$declined)
```

<!-- Started but never submitted (survey timestamp "[not completed]"). -->

```{r}
#| title: Incomplete Consent Forms
#| content: valuebox
list(icon = "hourglass-split", color = "vb-green", value = vb$incomplete)
```

<!-- Consent rate = consented / (consented + declined); incomplete forms are left out. -->

```{r}
#| title: Consent Rate
#| content: valuebox
list(icon = "percent", color = "vb-green", value = vb$rate)
```

## Row {height="5%" .fill}

```{r}
#| title: Patients Consented
#| content: valuebox
list(icon = "person", color = "vb-green", value = vb$patients)
```

```{r}
#| title: Caregivers Consented
#| content: valuebox
list(icon = "people", color = "vb-green", value = vb$caregivers)
```

<!-- Caregivers who chose to answer the survey about the care recipient. -->

```{r}
#| title: Caregiver Proxy Surveys
#| content: valuebox
list(icon = "person-badge", color = "vb-green", value = vb$proxy)
```

```{r}
#| title: Interested in Follow-Up Interview
#| content: valuebox
list(icon = "telephone", color = "vb-green", value = vb$followup)
```

## Row {height="5%" .fill}

<!-- A dyad counts once its Dyad Interview ID has both a patient and a caregiver consent. -->

```{r}
#| title: Dyads With Patient and Caregiver Consented
#| content: valuebox
list(icon = "link-45deg", color = "vb-green", value = vb$dyads_complete)
```

```{r}
#| title: Surveys Completed (End Form Complete)
#| content: valuebox
list(icon = "clipboard2-check", color = "vb-green", value = vb$surveys_complete)
```

<!-- ALL-ONLY-START -->

<!-- Complete dyads as a share of the dyad goal set in quant_consent_dashboard.qmd ({{GOAL}} is filled in from it). -->

```{r}
#| title: Progress to Goal ({{GOAL}} Dyads)
#| content: valuebox
list(icon = "flag", color = "vb-green", value = pct(vb$dyads_complete, enrollment_goal_dyads))
```

<!-- ALL-ONLY-END -->
